FILE.sha256: actual lowercase SHA256; parent supplies wrapper and manifest hashes after writing their actual bytes

wrapper: FILE for running observer, separate from trainer directory
output: same new path as argv[14], separate from trainer/wrapper directories and manifest/stdio/interpreter bindings; absent at admission
unit: parent's new unit name without .service; must match actual unified /proc/self/cgroup basename; original failed unit forbidden

stdio.stderr: parent canonical absolute stderr path; may equal stdout

events: flushed JSON lines on original sys.stdout; SOURCE_BEGIN, PHASE BEGIN/END, SOURCE_END on normal completion only; each diagnostic flag false; runtime INVOCATION_ID/unit/manifest_sha256 bound in SOURCE_BEGIN
end_semantics: sys.setprofile return event includes exception unwind; END never asserts successful return. Raised exception/SystemExit leaves SOURCE_BEGIN unmatched; no final summary is required on outer timeout.
trace_filename: exact authenticated root trainer filename only; copied source deliberately untraced; no file reads by callback or after target entry

bounds.on_limit: emit one TRUNCATED marker then stop observer writes; target continues

execution: compile authenticated bytes directly, no trainer import or pyc; fresh original __main__, canonical argv/file/path and SourceFileLoader metadata; restore existing sys profiler/main/argv/path in finally; preserve original error/SystemExit
verification: one final stdlib-only suite under timeout120 seconds and RLIMIT_AS1GiB; never run frozen trainer or native/GPU/remote work
parent_owns: both locks, CPU300/8GiB/zero swap/CUDA hidden, terminal admission/source closure/full cleanup and one prospective diagnostic only
